biography: Curt Lincoln, a name whispered with a mix of admiration and trepidation in racing paddocks, hails from the frozen landscapes of northern Sweden. Born into a family of lumberjacks, Curt’s initial aspirations were far removed from the roar of engines. However, a chance encounter with a local rallycross event ignited a passion that would consume him. He started tinkering with go-karts in his teens, often using spare parts scavenged from his father’s logging equipment. His raw talent quickly became apparent, and he soon transitioned to Formula Ford, where his aggressive driving style earned him both victories and notoriety. A defining moment came at the Scandinavian Formula 3 Championship, where, despite starting last after a qualifying mishap, he carved his way through the field to snatch a dramatic last-lap victory. Currently at the peak of his career, racing for Team F, Curt is a formidable contender, known for his relentless pursuit of victory and willingness to push the limits.
drivingStyle: Curt Lincoln's driving style can be best described as 'controlled aggression'. He is known for his late braking maneuvers and his uncanny ability to extract every ounce of grip from his tires. He attacks corners with a ferocity that often leaves rivals reeling, and he is not afraid to engage in wheel-to-wheel combat. Despite his aggressive approach, Curt possesses remarkable car control, allowing him to push the boundaries without frequently exceeding them. He's a master of tire management, able to conserve rubber when needed, then unleashing a burst of speed in the final laps.

rivalries.name: Alessandro Rossi
rivalries.reason: Rossi, a calculating Italian driver, represents the antithesis of Lincoln's wild style, leading to frequent clashes on and off the track.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Tanaka, a stoic and highly skilled Japanese driver, has been Lincoln's main championship competitor for the past two seasons, creating a fierce but respectful rivalry.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Dubois
rivalries.reason: Dubois, a rising star from France, publicly criticized Lincoln's aggressive tactics, sparking a heated exchange that has fueled their on-track battles.

quirks: Always wears the same worn-out leather driving gloves, claiming they bring him luck.
Listens to heavy metal music at full volume right before the start of every race to 'get the adrenaline pumping'.
Refuses to discuss race strategy with anyone except his chief engineer, believing too many opinions cloud his judgment.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser."
careerHighlight: Winning the Monaco Grand Prix after a daring overtake on the final corner, silencing critics who doubted his ability on street circuits.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the championship-deciding race in the final lap due to a mechanical failure, costing him his first title.
